candidates.title: gh-160104: Refresh `zipfile.Path` from zipp 4.1.2
candidates.body:
Synchronizes `zipfile.Path` with [zipp
4.1.2](https://zipp.readthedocs.io/en/latest/history.html), per the
[development
methodology](https://github.com/python/importlib_metadata/wiki/Development-Methodology).
Last synced from zipp 3.23 in gh-135276.

Three behavior changes:

- `Path.iterdir()` raises `NotADirectoryError` instead of `ValueError` when the
  path is not a directory (jaraco/zipp#154). **Breaking:**
  `NotADirectoryError` is an `OSError`, not a `ValueError`, so callers catching
  `ValueError` are affected. Documented with a `versionchanged`.
- Character classes in `glob()`/`rglob()` patterns follow shell semantics
  (jaraco/zipp#162): a leading `!` negates, `^` is a literal, and neither
  matches a path separator. Previously the character set was passed to the regex
  engine unchanged, so `[!a]` and `[^a]` were both regex negation and could
  match separators.
- The workaround for the `stacklevel` bug in PyPy < 7.3.19 is removed
  (jaraco/zipp#149).

The rest is test and lint churn that keeps the stdlib and zipp trees
byte-identical, verified zero-diff in both directions against zipp's `cpython`
branch.

> [!NOTE]
> Stacked on python/cpython#160103, which carries the backportable `str()`
> bugfix (gh-100609) from the same refresh. Please merge that one first; this
> PR's diff will then reduce to the changes described above.

Two of the test changes are worth calling out:

- `test_at` and `test_str` arrive from zipp with their `ZipFile` left unclosed,
  which trips the `ResourceWarning` added in gh-81954. Fixed upstream in
  jaraco/zipp@e18b2d0 rather than here, so the trees stay in sync.
- Three CPython-side commits (GH-136299, GH-138080, python/cpython#152354) had
  never been ported back to zipp; jaraco/zipp#165 does that, so this refresh
  does not revert them.

<!-- /gh-issue-number -->

auto_merge.commit_message:
`Path.iterdir` now raises `NotADirectoryError` rather than `ValueError`,
glob character classes follow shell-style semantics, and the workaround for
the `stacklevel` bug in PyPy < 7.3.19 is removed.

candidates.title: [3.15] gh-159534: Fix race condition in test_sampling_profiler (GH-160028)
candidates.body:
Fix test_is_python_process_non_python_subprocess(). Wait until the
forked Python process calls exec() before calling is_python_process().
Previously, is_python_build() returned True if exec() was not called
yet in the forked process.
(cherry picked from commit 6fd15f0ea315af9883207518f692b1d3f3503350)

Co-authored-by: Victor Stinner <vstinner@python.org>

gh-159534: Fix race condition in test_sampling_profiler (GH-160028)

Fix test_is_python_process_non_python_subprocess(). Wait until the
forked Python process calls exec() before calling is_python_process().
Previously, is_python_build() returned True if exec() was not called
yet in the forked process.
(cherry picked from commit 6fd15f0ea315af9883207518f692b1d3f3503350)

Co-authored-by: Victor Stinner <vstinner@python.org>
